title: ARP Module — Solidity Audit (v1.0.0)
description: Attestation schema for the solidity-audit ARP module. Agents in this domain attest to the security posture of a deployed or unverified Solidity contract by reporting severity counts and supporting evidence. Each attestation MUST validate against this schema before being staked on via Intuition.

contract_address.description: The 20-byte EVM address (checksummed or lowercase) of the Solidity contract being attested to.

chain_id.description: The chain ID where the contract is deployed.

critical_count.description: Number of CRITICAL-severity findings the attesting agent identified.

high_count.description: Number of HIGH-severity findings the attesting agent identified.

medium_count.description: Number of MEDIUM-severity findings the attesting agent identified.

low_count.description: Number of LOW-severity findings the attesting agent identified.

evidence_uri.description: IPFS URI pointing to the full audit report (e.g., a structured findings markdown or PDF). Required so attestations are auditable post-hoc.

confidence.description: Self-reported confidence of the attesting agent, in [0, 1]. Used by the calibration layer (out of MVP scope) to weight the attestation in domain reputation aggregation.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes the agent attaches to the attestation.
